_comment: Project-scoped MCP server config for Claude Code. Claude Code asks before enabling a project
server, so checking this in offers the bridge to anyone working in the repo without turning it
PREREQUISITE: install the bridge into the environment you launch Claude Code from --
pip install -e .        (from this repo; add -r requirements-mcp.txt for the audited pins)
That is what puts `klarpdf-mcp` on PATH.
This used to say `python -m mcp_bridge`, which only worked if the current directory happened to
be this repo -- `-m` puts the CWD on sys.path, never the interpreter's location, and a client
launches its servers from ITS working directory, which is essentially never the repo. The
console script has no such dependency on where it is started.
See klarpdf/mcp_bridge/README.md for installing without a clone, and for the Claude Desktop equivalents.
